# NullifyCV

NullifyCV helps recruiters and candidates redact selected identifiers from PDF/DOCX files in the browser. Review outputs; detection is not guaranteed complete and redacted CVs can remain identifiable.

## Pricing
- Free: basic single-file redaction.
- Single CV: €2.99 once, all redaction options for one source file, with selection corrections and repeat downloads.
- Batch: €49/year including applicable tax, renews annually until cancelled; unlimited processing with up to 200 files per batch, ZIP and workflow audit exports.
- Existing purchases keep their purchased terms.

## Data handling
CV redaction is local. Checkout temporarily stores the source file in the browser for return, then removes it after restoration or on the next visit after 24 hours. Licences and local file fingerprints use browser storage. Payment, licence validation, analytics (Vercel), error reporting (Sentry), hosting and external libraries involve online services. File fingerprints are not sent to the server. Logs describe application actions, not independent compliance certification or network measurements.
